facts.fact: The Sfax technopole's CoStarT incubator supports startups and entrepreneurs through coaching, mentoring and co-working, and firms entered Sfax through its incubation programmes, per the park's director general.
The Sfax technopole is in service with companies on site, employing 300 to 350 people, and plans a 15,000 m2 extension opening in 2028.
